description: End-to-end integration tests for the full Gold pipeline
steps: Write integration test: Silver trades → process-trades → ledger + position_state → verify correctness
Write integration test: Silver trades → compute-marks → market_mark_daily S3 + CH → verify values
Write integration test: full daily-run → all Gold tables populated → query CH and verify
Write integration test: ch-load with lookback → only recent partitions in CH
Write integration test: on-demand compute-snapshot → S3 cached + CH loaded

description: PnL accuracy tests with known trade sequences
steps: Create test fixture: synthetic trade sequence with hand-calculated expected PnL at each step
Test case 1: simple buy-sell cycle (buy 100 @ $0.50, sell 100 @ $0.70 → realized PnL = $20)
Test case 2: multiple buys at different prices, partial sell (average cost basis verification)
Test case 3: position flip (long to short via oversized sell)
Test case 4: concurrent positions in multiple markets for same wallet
Verify wallet_pnl_daily totals match sum of per-fill realized PnL from ledger

description: Validate data quality across all Gold tables
steps: Verify no null primary keys in any Gold table
Verify wallet_position_state has no rows with qty = 0
Verify wallet_pnl_daily has no rows with trades_count = 0
Verify market_mark_daily prices are within reasonable bounds (0 < price < 1 for prediction markets)
Verify all S3 Gold Parquet files are readable and schema-conformant

description: Documentation and runbooks for Gold operations
steps: Update CLAUDE.md with Gold CLI reference and environment variables
Document Gold S3 path conventions and ClickHouse table schemas
Create Gold operations runbook: daily processing, backfills, rebuilds, troubleshooting
Document the position accounting methodology (average cost basis, per-fill PnL)
Document freshness SLAs and alerting state definitions
